items.title: What the Democratic midterms sweep changes for U.S.-China relations
items.summary: BEIJING — Democrats taking power from Republicans in Congress raises risks for U.S.-China tensions around Taiwan, while hardening tech competition, analysts said.

items.title: 10-year Treasury yield slides as traders mull over Democrats' midterm victories, oil prices drop
items.summary: The 10-year Treasury yield fell on Wednesday as investors weighed big wins from Democrats in the U.S. midterm elections and oil prices pulled back.

items.title: The economy brought Trump back to power. Now it's his downfall
items.summary: As President Donald Trump campaigned for the nation's highest office in 2024, he regularly blamed Democrats for the country's economic anxiety.

items.title: Analysis: The Democrats have one chance to extract concessions from Trump. Markets will hate it
items.summary: The electoral sweep by Democrats on Tuesday night injects a new, unstable dynamic into the single biggest political risk to financial markets in the coming year: the debt limit .

items.title: Private companies added 86,000 jobs in October, slightly higher than expected, ADP says
items.summary: Private sector job growth held steady in October, with gains spread across sectors, as the labor market showed fresh signs of stabilization, ADP reported Wednesday.

items.title: Euro zone inflation hits 4% for first time in three years as interest rate hike looms
items.summary: Inflation in the euro area jumped to a three-year high of 4% in October, a flash estimate showed on Wednesday.
